# Source and local ownership

These skills adapt Lauren Tan's [pstack](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/c47b12849e43f18d5c374c7069c744cc55b0ea00/pstack) at commit `c47b12849e43f18d5c374c7069c744cc55b0ea00`:

- `pstack/skills/create-verification-skill`, including its feature-map example.
- `pstack/skills/maintain-verification-skill`.

Local changes use project-owned skill paths with `.agents/skills` as the default, add Codex metadata, preserve explicit-only invocation, make publication depend on authorization, and keep the workflows concise. Maintenance may delegate source reading for broad maps while retaining one writer and one live driver.

These are locally maintained adaptations, not byte-identical vendor copies. Review upstream changes before integrating them; do not overwrite the local instructions automatically. The upstream MIT notice is retained in `LICENSE`.
